We need to determine SMILES of an organic molecule given only "sample of an organic molecule" but no data. Likely we need to use measurement tools to get spectra. We need minimal but sufficient analysis. So we should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe NMR to deduce structure. Use tools: mass_spectrometry_spectra, then get formula via get_formula_from_smiles? Actually we need formula from mass. We can get isotopic distribution maybe. But we need to infer structure.

We have no initial guess. So we need to run mass spec.
